about: MUTATING — delete the forge branches whose cars landed BEFORE the database switch, on the ARCHIVE database's job records, by exactly the arriving train's sweep rule (infra/forge/sweep-archive-branches.sh <mode> <namespace> <archive-db>). Backlog dfd83788, measured 2026-09-17: boss orient listed 50 forge heads no packet claims — the arrival sweep deletes a landed car's branch on the JOB RECORD's evidence (train.rs deletable_branches + sweep_guard), and every car that landed before the 2026-09-16 23:55Z switch lives in the archive database, not the system of record, so the sweep can never see them. The rule is the sweep's, which is David's protocol decision for arrivals (train PRs squash-merge, so the job record is the proof), applied unchanged: a branch comes off iff a closed, merged ship-a-change car in the archive names it (metadata.branch with boarded_head, or a rerail_origins entry with its head) AND the branch's current head on the forge equals the recorded head. Moved = kept and named; a claim with no head = kept and named; a head no archive car claims = kept and named (an abandoned attempt, a never-filed branch, or a live car — a human's decision, listed for one); gone = counted. THE BOUNDS, each a refusal that changes nothing: the arguments (namespace boss or boss-<name>, never boss-dev; a plain lowercase database name); the archive must NOT be the database Secret boss-secrets/database-url names (parsed in a variable, THE PASSWORD IS NEVER PRINTED, a test asserts it) — that is the live system of record and the live sweep owns it; ONE read-only psql round trip through the kubectl-exec door tenant-census uses; the heads read with git ls-remote on the converged checkout's forgejo remote, whose URL (it may carry a token) is never printed; only a branch name of the shape [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]* is ever handed to git, as the full ref. --dry-run prints the plan and pushes nothing; --for-real is a human's decision to file: git push forgejo --delete per planned branch, each READ BACK with ls-remote (a forge answer is not a forge effect) and recorded. The verdict line prints FIRST (the runner keeps 100 KB), then the JSON record, then the per-branch lines.
